items.title: How to watch Apple’s foldable iPhone announcement
items.content: Apple's annual iPhone event will stream live on September 9 at 10 a.m. PDT, and we're expecting big news.

items.title: What we expect from the upcoming Apple launch
items.content: While Apple's first foldable iPhone Ultra will headline the September 9 launch, we're also expecting news about AirPods and HomePods.

items.title: Phil Schiller’s App Store exit reportedly driven by wariness over future plans
items.content: Schiller reportedly had reservations about new CEO John Ternus' goal of bringing in more recurring revenue from the App Store.

items.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
items.content: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on, but things are improving
items.content: Microsoft 365 and Outlook are still seeing service degradations on Tuesday, the company's status page indicates.

items.title: Microsoft tests fix for latest hours-long Outlook outage
items.content: Microsoft says it's testing a fix for the widespread Outlook issues that have led to email delays and failures.

items.title: Joseph Rice, Lowcountry Lawyer Who Took On Big Tobacco, Dies at 72
items.content: He challenged tobacco companies as well as the opioid industry, securing multibillion-dollar settlements that also benefited public health.

items.title: Treasury Plans $6 Billion in Debt Repurchases to Battle Rising Yields
items.content: Bond yields rose after the announcement, suggesting investors were underwhelmed by the size of the purchases.

items.title: Saudi Oil Exports Plunge as Spread of War Shuts Off Shipping Routes
items.content: With few good options for safely shipping oil, Saudi Arabia’s exports have plunged to a 13-year low.

items.title: Measuring the Cost of Trump’s Multiple Wars
items.content: Voters and some Republican lawmakers are growing weary of President Trump’s trade battles and the economic fallout from fighting in the Middle East.
